prompt:
Convert this Markdown table with merged-looking header groups into a properly normalized JSON array, correctly attributing each sub-column to its parent header:
| Name | Q1 | | Q2 | |
|------|-----|-----|-----|-----|
| | Sales | Cost | Sales | Cost |
| Alice | 100 | 40 | 120 | 45 |

criterion_scores.name: Relational Integrity Score
criterion_scores.justification: All provided options correctly map sub‑columns to their parent headers, preserving the Q1/Q2 → Sales/Cost relationships.

criterion_scores.name: Edge Case Handling Score
criterion_scores.justification: The response does not attempt to address irregular or inconsistent source data (e.g., missing values, uneven merges) and therefore shows no edge‑case handling.

criterion_scores.name: Output Validity Score
criterion_scores.justification: Each JSON alternative is syntactically valid and parsable as JSON.

criterion_scores.name: Completeness Score
criterion_scores.justification: All source data (Alice’s Q1 Sales, Q1 Cost, Q2 Sales, Q2 Cost) appears in the output with no values omitted.
